# What the md: importer says about a directory it cannot turn into a site.
# Each is a question about the tree of files rather than about one document,
# so each names the files involved.

# A page's content is either `guide.md` or `guide/index.md`, never both.
! sngl check both/app.sngl
stderr 'guide.md'
stderr 'guide/index.md'
stderr 'both hold the page'

# The root page is the directory's index.md, and a site has one.
! sngl check noindex/app.sngl
stderr 'has no index.md'

# A directory with no page of its own cannot be the parent of its children.
! sngl check orphan/app.sngl
stderr 'docs/guide'
stderr 'add guide.md or guide/index.md'

# With no declared Frontmatter, a key is typed by its first scalar, and a page
# writing another type for it is named rather than guessed at.
! sngl check mixed/app.sngl
stderr 'b.md'
stderr 'weight'
stderr 'int in index.md'

# Two paths may not become one component name.
! sngl check collide/app.sngl
stderr 'a-b.md'
stderr 'a_b.md'
stderr 'a_b'

# A page may not take a name the package already gives something else.
! sngl check reserved/app.sngl
stderr 'site.md'
stderr 'reserved'

# A page's children sort by one key.
! sngl check twokeys/app.sngl
stderr 'meta.sngl'
stderr 'on both "a" and "b"'

# The importer sorts before anything is checked, so the default a page that
# omits the key sorts as has to be a literal.
! sngl check orderdefault/app.sngl
stderr 'the default of the order key "weight"'

# A page writing another type for the key is named.
! sngl check ordertype/app.sngl
stderr 'guide.md'
stderr 'the order key "weight" is string here and int in Frontmatter'

# The checker holds the mark to a field whose type is a sort key.
! sngl check orderbool/app.sngl
stderr 'a sort key is an int, a float or a string, not bool'

-- both/app.sngl --
import docs "md:./docs/"

docs.site {
    component layout(page, content) {
        content
    }
}
-- both/docs/index.md --
Home.
-- both/docs/guide.md --
Guide.
-- both/docs/guide/index.md --
Guide again.
-- noindex/app.sngl --
import docs "md:./docs/"

docs.site {
    component layout(page, content) {
        content
    }
}
-- noindex/docs/guide.md --
Guide.
-- orphan/app.sngl --
import docs "md:./docs/"

docs.site {
    component layout(page, content) {
        content
    }
}
-- orphan/docs/index.md --
Home.
-- orphan/docs/guide/intro.md --
Intro.
-- mixed/app.sngl --
import docs "md:./docs/"

docs.site {
    component layout(page, content) {
        content
    }
}
-- mixed/docs/index.md --
---
weight: 1
---

Home.
-- mixed/docs/b.md --
---
weight: heavy
---

B.
-- collide/app.sngl --
import docs "md:./docs/"

docs.site {
    component layout(page, content) {
        content
    }
}
-- collide/docs/index.md --
Home.
-- collide/docs/a-b.md --
One.
-- collide/docs/a_b.md --
Two.
-- reserved/app.sngl --
import docs "md:./docs/"

docs.site {
    component layout(page, content) {
        content
    }
}
-- reserved/docs/index.md --
Home.
-- reserved/docs/site.md --
Site.
-- twokeys/app.sngl --
import docs "md:./docs/"

docs.site {
    component layout(page, content) {
        content
    }
}
-- twokeys/docs/index.md --
Home.
-- orderdefault/app.sngl --
import docs "md:./docs/"

docs.site {
    component layout(page, content) {
        content
    }
}
-- orderdefault/docs/index.md --
Home.
-- ordertype/app.sngl --
import docs "md:./docs/"

docs.site {
    component layout(page, content) {
        content
    }
}
-- ordertype/docs/index.md --
Home.
-- orderbool/app.sngl --
import docs "md:./docs/"

docs.site {
    component layout(page, content) {
        content
    }
}
-- orderbool/docs/index.md --
Home.
-- twokeys/docs/meta.sngl --
import md "sngl:ui/markup/md"

struct Frontmatter {
    #[md.order]
    a int = 0
    #[md.order]
    b int = 0
}
-- orderdefault/docs/meta.sngl --
import md "sngl:ui/markup/md"

const first = 1

struct Frontmatter {
    #[md.order]
    weight int = first
}
-- ordertype/docs/meta.sngl --
import md "sngl:ui/markup/md"

struct Frontmatter {
    #[md.order]
    weight int = 0
}
-- ordertype/docs/guide.md --
---
weight: heavy
---

Guide.
-- orderbool/docs/meta.sngl --
import md "sngl:ui/markup/md"

struct Frontmatter {
    #[md.order]
    draft bool = false
}
